references.text: The census of the Gershonites is also mentioned here, where the number of men was recorded according to their clans.
Another count of the Gershonites showing the same total: 2,750 men.
The clans of the Levites, including the Gershonites, are counted again in the second census.
The context for the census of the Kohathites according to their clans, which shows the same pattern for Levitical service.
A summary of the entire Levite census, presenting the total of all Levitical clans of serving age.
